strategy_name: Microfish Live Moneyline — Certainty Floor Discovery
data_source: ESPN play-by-play win probability, 2364 games, 2025 MLB season

tiers.name: Tier 1: Blowout Lock
tiers.description: Team leading by 5+ runs in 8th+ inning with 99%+ ESPN WP

tiers.name: Tier 2: Comfortable Lead
tiers.description: Team leading by 4+ runs in 8th+ inning with 96%+ ESPN WP

tiers.name: Tier 3: Late Lock
tiers.description: Team leading by 3+ runs in 9th inning with 95%+ ESPN WP

aggressive_tiers.name: Aggressive 1: High Volume
aggressive_tiers.description: 5+ run lead in 7th+ at 99% WP. 1 loss in 516 (NYM blew 6-run lead at WSH)

aggressive_tiers.name: Aggressive 2: Mid Volume
aggressive_tiers.description: 4+ run lead in 8th+ at 99% WP. 2 losses in 608 games.

execution.instruction: Monitor live MLB games. When a team meets any tier conditions, place a LIMIT BUY order at the tier limit price. The order fills because the team is already at that win probability. You profit the difference between your buy price and $1.00 when they win.

notable_comebacks: ATL reached 100% WP (inn 3) vs ARI but lost 11-10
MIL reached 100% WP (inn 7) vs ARI but lost 4-5
PIT reached 100% WP (inn 1) vs COL but lost 16-17
LAD reached 100% WP (inn 9) vs BAL but lost 3-4
NYM had 6-run lead at 99% (inn 7) vs WSH but lost 7-8
risk_notes: Even these 100% accuracy combos are based on one season of data (2,364 games). Baseball has infinite variance — a 5-run lead in the 8th CAN be blown. The profit per bet is small ($0.01-$0.05/share) so any single loss wipes out 20-100 wins. The strategy depends on Polymarket having sufficient liquidity at these high prices to fill orders quickly.
